name: Logos free icons
about: Logos free icons is a free, open-source icon set with 1,362 icons designed by Streamline. Ideal for login buttons, partner walls, tech-stack badges and social links - every logo is a clean vector. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.

faqs.q: Are Logos free icons free to use?
faqs.a: The icon files themselves are open source under the CC BY 4.0 license – free to download and use. But company logos are trademarks of their owners, so always check each brand's usage guidelines before commercial use.

faqs.q: Can I use Logos free icons logos in commercial projects?
faqs.a: You can freely download and embed the vector files under the CC BY 4.0 license, but trademark law still applies: don't imply endorsement by a brand, and follow each company's brand guidelines for clear-space, colors and minimum sizes.

faqs.q: How do I use Logos free icons in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many Logos free icons are there?
faqs.a: There are 1,362 icons in the Logos free icons set, designed by Streamline. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: What formats are Logos free icons available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
